teachingCards.title: Category Overview
teachingCards.content:
Categories: Loud • Quiet

One of these words describes a peaceful feeling more than a specific sound. Sort into Loud or Quiet.

teachingCards.title: Thematic Rationale
teachingCards.content: Clamor and uproar both describe loud, chaotic noise from a crowd. Whisper and murmur both describe very quiet speech, with murmur often describing a low, continuous sound. Serenity describes a peaceful state or atmosphere, not just quiet sound.

teachingCards.title: Word Meanings
teachingCards.content:
Serenity: a calm, peaceful state
Murmur: a low, continuous, quiet sound
Whisper: very quiet speech, using breath rather than the voice
Clamor: a loud confused noise, often from a crowd
Uproar: a loud, excited outbreak of noise or protest
